# @berth/plugin, vendored

Types only, copied from Shipyard's `packages/plugin-sdk` at the tag in `scripts/sync-sdk.sh`, under Shipyard's MIT license (`LICENSE`). At runtime the app provides the real SDK. It's vendored because pnpm installs a whole repo rather than one folder for a git dependency with a lockfile. Don't edit it here: run the script to move to a newer tag.
